title: The *Unresolvable* Risk
dek: NYC subpoenaed four AI labs to testify on safety. Under oath, they confirmed: the risk can't be quantified and can't be eliminated. The deployment schedule is unchanged.

still_signal: The labs confirmed under oath: they cannot guarantee their systems will behave as intended. Two model families shipped the same week. The regulatory and deployment clocks run differently.
